summary: Invoice ingestion failing: nonstandard remittance characters prevent PO mapping and block scheduled payment
description:
Issue summary: An incoming supplier invoice PDF for vendor 'EkoBaza Ltd.' failed automated ingestion. The OCR/parsing pipeline could not extract the remittance reference and invoice number because the page contains nonstandard Unicode characters (zero-width joiners and Devanagari glyphs in the remittance line) plus an unusual BOM/encoding combination. Impact: Invoice failed PO mapping and GL code assignment; invoice was routed to the AP exception queue and missed the scheduled payment window for the T+5 payrun. This is blocking a payment to EkoBaza (small vendor) and requires manual intervention to avoid supplier escalation.

Environment: Production AP ingestion pipeline, eu-west region. Ingestion handled by ap-ingest service (v3.8.1) with OCR fallback to tesseract v5.0.0 and pdftext extraction via pdfminer.six.

Observed behavior: ap-ingest created an exception: 'no_invoice_id_parsed' and 'vendor_name_mismatch' because parsed remittance string was empty; OCR text output contains glyph placeholders and unprintable characters. Expected behavior: invoice metadata (invoice number, date, remittance ref, PO number) should be extracted and matched to PO so payment can be scheduled.

Attachments: raw PDF (uploaded to internal S3 as s3://redwood-internal/ap-exceptions/2026-03-08/ekobaza-invoice-10072.pdf), OCR output snippets, AP exception ticket snapshot.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Upload the attached PDF to the ap-ingest endpoint used by AP intake (same file used by customer finance team).
2) Observe ap-ingest pipeline logs for that file id and watch parsing stage where 'extract_metadata' runs.
3) Confirm OCR fallback to tesseract returns text containing U+200D (zero-width joiner) and Devanagari characters in remittance line; pdfminer returns empty string for that region.
4) Verify that PO lookup returns no match and the invoice is routed to AP exception queue (status: exception/no_invoice_id_parsed).
logs: 2026-03-08T14:07:12Z ap-ingest[pid:2234] INFO received file ekobaza-invoice-10072.pdf, size=178KB
2026-03-08T14:07:14Z ap-ingest[pid:2234] ERROR no_invoice_id_parsed; routing to exceptions queue; exception_id=EXC-20260308-4521
Payments queue: scheduled payrun (T+5) evaluated at 2026-03-09T02:00:00Z; invoice not present in payout file.
investigation_notes: Finance Ops (R. Singh) confirmed vendor email and PDF attachment are unchanged compared to prior invoices where ingestion succeeded; this PDF contains a supplier-generated footer with bilingual text (English + Marathi) and a remittance line with nonbreaking spaces.
AP ingestion engineer (L. O'Connor) ran local reproduction: pdfminer returned empty text for the remittance area; tesseract OCR returned text with replacement characters and ZWJ (U+200D).

Engineering hypothesis: current extraction step assumes ASCII/UTF-8 continuity and strips control chars; presence of ZWJ/ZWNJ plus a UTF-16LE BOM inside the stream causes pdfminer to skip a text block and fallback OCR to mis-classify characters.

Temporary workaround trial: manual copy/paste of invoice number and PO into AP UI allowed creation of payment instruction; Payments Ops created one-off manual pay instruction (MANPAY-2026-113) to avoid supplier hold.
Related systems checked: bank validation passed for vendor bank details; no KYC or block flags on supplier profile.
comments: 2026-03-09 09:12 - Priya Shah (Finance Ops): Vendor called and asked for ETA. We escalated to AP ingestion. Please prioritize - invoice is P2 but vendor is responsive.

2026-03-09 11:05 - Liam O'Connor (AP ingestion): I reproduced locally. Attaching ocr_raw.txt. Looks like U+FEFF (BOM) in the middle of content and several ZWJ characters. Routing to engineering for parser tolerance changes.

2026-03-10 08:37 - Rahul Mehta (Infra): We can add a pre-normalization filter to strip zero-width characters and try pdfminer with explicit encoding handling. Will open a PR for ap-ingest parser fallback (see PR link).

2026-03-11 15:20 - Payments Ops (S. Alvarez): Manual pay instruction MANPAY-2026-113 created and queued for next manual batch. Confirmed vendor notified; close to on-time payment. Finance asked to keep this ticket open until pipeline is fixed and a regression test is added.
2026-03-12 10:47 - Liam O'Connor: Added unit test for ZWJ/ZWNJ normalization and updated exception handling to mark these as 'encoding-exception' so AP can triage automatically. Pending code review.
2026-03-12 12:30 - Priya Shah: Please ensure ops logs will surface similar invoices for the last 30 days so we can check if other suppliers were impacted.
